verdict.rationale: Google Drive is a cloud storage and collaboration product with AI add-on surfaces, so asking whether it can consume MCP servers' tools is a fair axis. However, the evidence pack never mentions connecting MCP servers. The only AI-related item describes building an agent add-on with ADK and Vertex AI Agent Engine, which is a developer building block and not an MCP-client capability of Drive itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
